mohtat2020-graphite-ocp-material.description: Peyman MPM / Mohtat2020 implementation, as attributed by upstream function docstrings; The implementation specifies a 5 Ah graphite/NMC532 pouch. Commercial manufacturer, part number, specimen mapping and matching raw full-cell files are not established in this release. SINTEF NMC532 half-cells are a separate source and are not assigned to this pouch.

nca-kim2011-graphite-ocp-material.description: Kim2011 nominal-design implementation; A nominal design, not an identified commercial cell. No matching raw test is assigned.
